2228-3025-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-3025-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-3025-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

339-677-3480-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-3480-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-7060-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

573-2174-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
573-2174-2645-3430.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

757-1543-5087-5524.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-1543-5087-5524.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Ichormoon Gauntlet to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Destiny Spinner, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2919-4094-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2919-4094-5086-5183.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-3703-5413.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3703-5413.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-7083-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Baloth Prime trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Baloth Prime trigger, untapping it and creating a tapped 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat.

341-3532-3949-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
341-3532-3949-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

2104-4423-4935-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2104-4423-4935-6886.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1115-3292-3892.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-1115-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

1978-3430-6006.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1978-3430-6006.description:
Activate an artifact creature by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature.
Repeat.

1860-5657-6489.manaNeeded: {5}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
1860-5657-6489.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
1860-5657-6489.description:
Activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells as though they have flash this turn.
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 6.

440-1339-1786-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1786-2034.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Queza trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Queza trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

372-673-1809.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-673-1809.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

254-618-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and that does not have summoning sickness.
254-618-4613.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

273-2512-2603.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Shuko ability, attaching it to Daru Spiritualist.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

851-3199-3209.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
851-3199-3209.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat step 4.

553-1827.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
553-1827.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Vampiric Tutor by paying {B}, searching your library for Approach of the Second Sun and putting it on top of your library and causing you to lose 2 life.
Draw Approach of the Second Sun from your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

2178-2310-3329.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Diaochan.
Diaochan does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2310-3329.description:
Activate Soul of New Phyrexia's first ability by paying {5}, giving permanents you control indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Diaochan by tapping it, destroying an opponent's creature and any creature of that opponent's choice.
If the opponent chooses a creature you control to be destroyed, it is not destroyed due to it having indestructible.
The creature the opponent controls dies, triggering Diaochan, untapping Diaochan.
Repeat from step 2.

22-1530.notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
Opponents can not kill Silent Sentinel when you attack.
Silent Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
22-1530.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Second Chance and take an extra turn.
Attack with Silent Sentinel, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield under your control.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
